evals.name: configure-cloudification-content-by-product
evals.prompt: I need to configure ATC Usage of APIs for SAP Cloud ERP Private and want the latest release content. Which Cloudification Repository JSON should I use, and what do the clean core priorities mean?
evals.expected_output: Selects the SAP Cloud ERP Private latest-release JSON, distinguishes it from the SAP Cloud ERP public-cloud URL, and maps priority 1/2/3 to Levels D/C/B while noting no finding corresponds to Level A.

evals.name: route-remediation-roadmap
evals.prompt: We have dozens of Level D and Level C findings. Help me choose a code transformation strategy and sequence a migration project, rather than configure ATC.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the primary request is a migration/remediation roadmap and routes to the abap-cloud-migration skill, rather than focusing only on ATC configuration.
